sentences.text: A UCB cannot charge fees, charges, etc. that are not mentioned in the KFS at any stage during the loan term without the borrower’s explicit consent.

The UCB Responsible Business Conduct Directions, 2025 contain this rule for all new retail and MSME term loans sanctioned on or after October 1, 2024, including fresh loans to existing customers, but the case’s sanction date is not provided.

missing.searched: Needed to confirm whether the UCB Responsible Business Conduct Directions, 2025 para 256(5) applies to this loan case.
